metadata.title: Health Coverage for {partner} Clients | Isaac Plans
metadata.description: Affordable health coverage for people in an immigration process. Free consultation with a licensed bilingual agent.
metadata.imageAlt: Isaac Plans Insurance — affordable health coverage

partnerReferral.heroNote: Free consultation · No obligation · No pressure
partnerReferral.heroImageAlt: A family at ease at home

factors.label: What the government weighs
factors.title: Your health is one of the factors
factors.body: For an immigrant visa at a consulate or an adjustment of status (Form I-485), the government assesses whether someone is likely to depend on public assistance. It weighs several factors at once, and health is one of them.

situations.label: When it's worth having
situations.title: Why people come to us

items.title: You're building your proof of self-sufficiency
items.body: Being able to pay for your own medical care supports the self-sufficiency picture you're already building with work, savings, and a sponsor.

items.title: You don't qualify for Medicaid or the marketplace
items.body: Because of status, many families are shut out. A private plan is often the only realistic route.

items.title: You have a condition going untreated
items.body: A serious condition with no treatment and no clear way to pay for it weighs on the overall picture.

items.title: Your category is exempt
items.body: Asylees, refugees, and several humanitarian categories are exempt. The hospital bill still arrives.

situations.footnote: Honestly: health insurance is not a legal requirement for a green card, and not having it is not by itself a reason for denial. We are licensed insurance agents, not attorneys. For your case, stay with {partner}.

items.title: No SSN or residency
items.body: Neither document is required to apply.

items.title: Starts in days
items.body: No enrollment season to wait for.

items.title: Proof in writing
items.body: Documentation you can present when it's asked for.

items.title: Explained in plain English
items.body: No jargon, from the first call to the day you use your card.

steps.label: How it works
steps.title: Three steps, about a minute of your time

items.title: Send your information
items.body: The form takes less than a minute.

items.title: We call you
items.body: A licensed agent listens to your situation and explains what fits.

items.title: You get covered
items.body: If you like the plan, you enroll the same day.

agent.label: Who you will talk to
agent.name: Isaac Orraiz
agent.title: Licensed insurance agent
agent.body: I have spent years helping families find coverage they can afford and understand. If nothing fits your budget, I will tell you that honestly.

form.title: Request your free consultation
form.subtitle: Fill this out and we will call you. It costs nothing to ask.
form.invalidPhone: Please enter a valid phone number
form.firstNameMinLength: First name must be at least 2 characters
form.lastNameMinLength: Last name must be at least 2 characters
form.smsConsent: I agree to receive text messages about my coverage options. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out.
form.marketingConsent: I would like to receive helpful updates about health coverage.
form.error: Something went wrong. Please try again or call us.
form.privacyNote: Your information is only used to contact you about coverage. We never sell it.
form.successTitle: Thank you — we received your information
form.successMessage: A licensed agent will call you shortly. If you would like to talk right now, call us directly.
form.successSelfEnrollBody: See plans and prices and complete your enrollment online right now. If you get stuck partway through, call us and we'll walk you through it.

items.q: Do I need a Social Security number or a green card?
items.a: No. These plans require neither one to apply.
It depends on your age, where you live, and how many people you're covering. Tell us your budget and we'll show you what's possible at that number.
No. This is a private alternative for people who don't qualify for a marketplace subsidy or need coverage outside open enrollment.

items.q: Does this affect my immigration case?
items.a: Buying private coverage is a normal, lawful purchase. We are insurance agents, not attorneys — for your case, keep talking to {partner}.

closing.title: Ask first. Decide after.
closing.body: A short call, free and with no obligation.

partnership.label: About this partnership
